category_edits.rationale: Normalize input item embeddings by RMS before dropout to control GRU input magnitudes while keeping padding zero. Preserve candidate embeddings, parameter tying, and all other settings. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so inference uses identical normalization without writer changes.

edits.find:
def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
edits.replace:
def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.item_emb(seq)
        emb = emb * torch.rsqrt(emb.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        emb = emb.masked_fill(seq.eq(0).unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
        emb = self.dropout(emb)
